title: Finite near-regular hypergraph rounding
abstract: Formalizes a finite ceiling-carrying nibble theorem for uniform hypergraphs that are near-regular outside a small exceptional set and have suitably bounded codegrees. The result is a reusable rounding component for extremal-combinatorial applications.

informal.LeanPool.AsymptoticTrianglePacking.nearR: For every uniformity and positive error tolerance, sufficiently large finite uniform hypergraphs with bounded codegrees, near-regular degrees outside a small exceptional set, and a global degree ceiling admit a matching covering the prescribed fraction of their vertices.
